tools.lanternNoMatch: The lantern went out: need matches
tools.lanternWind: The wind blew out the lantern!
tools.looseSnow: loose snow: scoop it with a shovel
tools.noFlame: Nothing to light the torch with
touch.radialCap: Pick an item · tap outside to close
touch.rotateHint: SNOWCRAFT is played in landscape orientation
unstuck.hint: Stuck? Dig sideways or up with the shovel, or press U.
unstuck.out: You dug yourself out of the snow.
unstuck.shake: Snow buried you. You shook it off.
useA.bdNone: Nothing to treat: no frostbite, no scar
useA.bdTip: Bandage: stand with the frostbitten part of your body and use it. If there is alcohol in the bag, it is used to treat the wound first: heals twice as well.
useA.bmTip: Fat balm: rub on hands and face before going out in the cold. Frostbite progresses 40% slower for about two hours.
useA.bmUsed: Rubbed on hands and face: for two hours
useA.bpTip: Reinforced backpack: while in the bag, six extra slots and 20 more kg of load, but you sweat 20% more.
useA.bpUse: Backpack: six more slots and +20 kg, but you sweat more
useA.flFroze: The water in the flask froze! Put it in the bag (under the parka) or set it by the fire
useA.gBlind: Snow glare: it stings your eyes. Put on goggles or step into shade
useA.gBlind2: Snow blindness: you can barely see!
useA.gTip: Goggles: wear them on your face. Without them on a bright day the snow blinds you, and in a blizzard the drift hits your face.
useA.hwLit: The hand warmer glows: {h} h of warmth
useA.hwNeed: Need coal and a burning fire nearby
useA.hwOut: The hand warmer burned out: need new coal
useA.hwStatus: The hand warmer still burns for {h} h
useA.hwTip: Hand warmer: put coal in it and light it by a fire. While it burns and is in your bag, hands and face freeze more slowly, and hands warm up.
useA.pcTip: Belt pouch: while in the bag, three quick slots on the belt (keys 7, 8, 9).
useA.pcUse: Pouch on the belt: three quick slots (keys 7, 8, 9)
useA.skEmpty: Nothing to pour: need snow, ice, coal or lichen
useA.skTip: Sack: pour in loose items (snow, ice, coal, lichen), up to 12 pieces: half the weight. To use again: add more or dump out. Wet snow soaks your clothes.
useA.skWet: Wet snow in the sack soaked your clothes
useA.spDrink: It burns the throat, you feel hot... but it's a trick: the body is cooling
useA.spTip: Alcohol: for wounds and frostbite together with a bandage. If you drink it, you feel warm, but the body loses heat faster. This is how people freeze to death.
useA.thCooled: The thermos has cooled: there is still water, but it no longer warms
useA.thNoSource: Nothing to fill it with: need a hot kettle, a pot of warm water, or water and a fire nearby
useA.thSip: A hot sip: warmth spreads through you
useA.thSipCold: A cold sip: water, but no warmth
useA.thTip: Thermos: fill it with hot water or tea by a fire, kettle or pot (empty thermos + use). Three sips: they warm and quench, and the warmth lasts about six hours.
useB.binDark: Dark: only what's close is visible
useB.binTip: Binoculars: hold LMB and the camera looks twice as far. In moonlight, aurora or at twilight, animals are visible at long range.
useB.clNeedBoots: Ice cleats attach to footwear: first put on boots or felt boots
useB.clTip: Ice cleats: strap onto boots or felt boots. Press to strap on or take off.
useB.cmpTip: Compass: press for the next target (station, schooner, signal hill, smoke, marks). Hold 0.6 s to mark this spot.
useB.prBridge: On step {n} ahead: a snow bridge over a gap
useB.prGround: Ahead is not ice: ground or stone
useB.prHole: On step {n} ahead: a polynya, clear water
useB.prIce: Ice ahead {cm} cm: passable, but thin
useB.prThin: On step {n} ahead: ice {cm} cm, thin. Don't walk
useB.prTip: Probe pole: poke the snow in front of you. It shows ice thickness, polynyas and voids under the snow up to six steps ahead. Visible on the snow for three seconds.
useB.prVoid: On step {n} ahead: ice over a void
useB.smLit: Smoke flare burning: smoke visible from afar, three minutes
useB.smTip: Smoke flare: light it. Thick smoke for three minutes, visible from afar by day and at twilight. The icebreaker takes it as a signal.
useB.whNoDog: Sever isn't nearby, nobody to whistle for
useB.whTip: Whistle: blow it and Sever comes running and follows you. Hold it to let him wait in place.
